svg.text: OPEN DESIGN REGISTRY / ICON SET PROPOSAL
Regular · 256px grid · native paths · same UI, typography and spacing
An open design system for thoughtful interfaces.
Make the next action easy to find.
Icons support recognition; consequential actions keep their text.
Official SVG source paths preserved. Fictional project. Proposal only; selection pending.
